info.syllabusName: Quản lý sản xuất và vận hành (Production  and Operation Management)
info.description: This course provides an in-depth exploration of Production and Operations Management (POM), emphasizing its strategic role in both manufacturing and service sectors. Students will be introduced to the scope and functions of operations management, global operations strategies, project planning, forecasting methods, product and service design, and sustainable operations. The course also equips learners with analytical tools such as statistical process control, capacity and bottleneck analysis, inventory models, material requirements planning (MRP), enterprise resource planning (ERP), and short-term scheduling techniques. In addition, it highlights lean operations, maintenance, and reliability as essential components for achieving operational excellence. Through a combination of lectures, case studies, simulations, and group projects, students will develop the ability to apply quantitative tools, evaluate process and quality strategies, and propose integrated solutions for production planning, lean management, and sustainable supply chain practices. By the end of the course, learners will be equipped with the knowledge and skills necessary to contribute effectively to organizational competitiveness and operational efficiency in a global environment.

clos.loDetails: Students will be equipped with foundational knowledge of Operations Management, including its scope, roles, and strategic decisions, enabling them to recognize its significance for organizational competitiveness and success.

Students will gain the ability to apply quantitative tools such as forecasting models, statistical process control, and capacity analysis, equipping them to analyze data and address practical operational challenges.

Students will be able to evaluate alternative quality practices, process strategies, and capacity planning methods, thereby being equipped to make informed judgments that improve operational performance.

Students will be capable of proposing integrated production planning and control solutions through the use of inventory, MRP, ERP, and scheduling tools, equipping them to design coherent operational plans.

Students will be able to create and present practical solutions for lean operations and sustainable supply chains, thereby being equipped with competencies to contribute to efficiency and long-term competitiveness.
